arguments.analyst: Observed bright variants cluster around conservative aliphatic swaps at T97, I229, M233 (O6, O9 > 3.78), while M233V in a different context (O10, K85R:M233V) falls to 3.33, indicating position effects are context-dependent rather than additive. I therefore test menu candidates carrying these same conservative aliphatic edits against otherwise conservative background pairs.
arguments.hypothesis: Conservative same-class aliphatic edits at T97/I229/M233 (as in O6 T97S:I229V and O9 D210E:M233V) preserve high brightness when paired only with other conservative substitutions, whereas identical edits in a non-conservative context (O10) lose brightness; menu pairs of conservative class-matched edits should therefore score in the bright band and outscore pairs containing non-conservative changes.

decision.analyst: Observed bright variants cluster around conservative aliphatic swaps at T97, I229, M233 (O6, O9 > 3.78), while M233V in a different context (O10, K85R:M233V) falls to 3.33, indicating position effects are context-dependent rather than additive. I therefore test menu candidates carrying these same conservative aliphatic edits against otherwise conservative background pairs.
decision.hypothesis: Conservative same-class aliphatic edits at T97/I229/M233 (as in O6 T97S:I229V and O9 D210E:M233V) preserve high brightness when paired only with other conservative substitutions, whereas identical edits in a non-conservative context (O10) lose brightness; menu pairs of conservative class-matched edits should therefore score in the bright band and outscore pairs containing non-conservative changes.
decision.critic: Estimates span only 0.11 log units with substantial uncertainty; they are fitted predictions, not measurements, and context-dependent.
decision.selection_rationale: Top five by predicted brightness; C32 and C31 carry I229T, C16 tests M233T, C06 and C12 are conservative controls.
